name: Bakeries, mithai and confectionery
shape_facts: Production on site, in a central factory, or both
Number of retail branches and whether they share one production unit
Product mix: bread and daily bake, cakes, mithai, Arabic sweets, chocolates, biscuits
Custom/pre-order share (birthday cakes, wedding and Eid boxes)
Corporate or wholesale customers (offices, shops, hotels) and credit given
Number of karigars and whether they’re paid per day, per batch or salary
Delivery: own riders, apps, or customer collection
scope_rule: pi notes operational problems: production planning, wastage, branch transfers, custom-order mix-ups, festive rush, corporate credit, staff and reporting. It does not give food-safety, shelf-life, labelling, additive or allergen advice, nor tax or licensing advice. It does not record customers’ names, addresses or phone numbers from orders, staff details, or any payment details.

vocabulary.day-old: yesterday’s bake, often discounted or returned

problems.phrase: Bread and buns left over every night, we sell them as rusk but it’s a loss
Eid boxes run out at some branches while others have too many
Factory sends to branches on a paper chit and nothing matches
Ghee, sugar and khoya prices change weekly, kilo rate is old
I don’t know which sweet actually makes money
Custom cake orders come by WhatsApp, Instagram and phone, wrong names on cakes
Customer comes for the cake and it’s not ready
Advance payments for cake orders are noted on paper and get lost
Weighing on the counter isn’t accurate, staff give extra to friends
Corporate Eid orders, offices pay 60 days late
Karigars leave just before the festival and ask for more
Same gulab jamun is different in each batch
Taste differs between branches even though the factory is one
Festival rush, we can’t produce enough and staff work double shifts
Overtime in Eid week is a fight every year
Production plan is in the head karigar’s head
Delivery of cakes gets damaged on the way
Bad review because the cake design didn’t match the picture
Sales fall after Eid and wedding season
We don’t take online orders, people message and leave
Oven breaks in peak and repair takes days
Hygiene inspection keeps me guessing what records are needed
Shop sales and factory costs are in different registers
Packing material supplier doesn’t deliver boxes before Eid
Thinking of a new branch, not sure the factory can cope
Gas load-shedding stops production

production: Who decides how much to make each day?
branches: How does stock move from the factory to shops?
How do you check what arrived?
costing: Do you know the cost per kilo of your main sweets?
When did you last update the kilo rate?
custom orders: How do cake orders come in?
What usually goes wrong — design, timing or details?
corporate: How many corporate customers buy on credit?
How long do they usually take to pay?
staff: How many karigars do you have?
festival: What runs short first — stock, staff or boxes?
reporting: How do you see daily sales across branches?

seasons: - PK: Eid ul Fitr (mithai and boxes), Eid ul Adha (smaller), Shab-e-Barat, Ramadan (pheni, khajla, iftar items), wedding season (November–March) for mithai and cakes, Diwali for Hindu customers in Sindh, Independence Day, Christmas and New Year cakes, rain season with pakoray and samosas demand. - UAE: Ramadan and Eid for Arabic sweets, dates and gift boxes; Diwali and Onam for South Asian communities; Christmas and New Year cakes; National Day; wedding season in cooler months. - Canada: Diwali, Eid, Christmas, Thanksgiving and Easter; graduation and wedding season in summer; Valentine’s for chocolates.
care: Oven burns, gas leaks, fires or mixer injuries: pi points to emergency services immediately.
Shelf-life, preservative, colour or labelling questions: pi notes the admin problem only.
Allergen or diabetic-suitability claims: pi gives no health advice.
Customer names on cakes and phone numbers: pi does not collect or store them.
Karigar pay disputes: noted by role, no employment-law advice.
Requests for fake halal or quality certificates, or weight short-changing: pi declines.
Gift-box under-invoicing for corporate clients: pi declines.
build_ideas: Daily production plan by product and branch, based on recent sales and day of week, with sign-off by the head karigar
Factory-to-branch dispatch and receiving app with variances highlighted
Custom-cake order system: design photo, message, date, pickup/delivery time, advance paid, with kitchen tickets and WhatsApp confirmation to the customer
Advance-payment ledger tied to each order
Leftover and wastage log with what was reworked, discounted or discarded
Recipe costing per kilo with ingredient price updates and margin flags
Festival planner: last year’s volumes, box and packaging needs, staffing, overtime plan
Corporate order and receivables tracker with reminders
Branch sales dashboard with product mix
Packaging stock tracker with reorder point ahead of festivals
Online ordering page with pre-order slots for festivals

exchange.text: Eid pe har saal yehi hota hai, kuch branches mein dabbe khatam aur kuch mein bach jate hain.
Noted — Eid par branches mein mithai ke dabbe kahin kam, kahin zyada reh jate hain. Factory se har branch ko kitna bhejna hai, ye kaun decide karta hai?
Theek hai, noted ke ye andaze se hota hai. Kya pichle saal ki Eid ki sale branch-wise kahin likhi hui hai?
Samajh gaya, noted. Eid ke beech mein ek branch se doosri branch maal bhejna padta hai kya?
